page_title: DevKnife – Essential Developer Tools on macOS

sources.entry: DevKnife - A native Mac app for dozens of daily dev tasks, from network scans to JSON formatting.

summary.name: DevKnife
summary.one_liner: DevKnife is a native macOS app bundling everyday developer tools such as a JSON editor, HTTP client, DNS inspector, format converter, regex tester, text compare, JWT debugger and port scanner.
keywords: json yaml toml xml csv converter
use_cases: convert data between JSON, YAML, TOML, XML and CSV
check whether a port is open or a firewall blocks it
summary.what_it_does: The app provides a JSON editor with a collapsible tree view, JSONPath or JMESPath querying, and auto-repair of broken JSON. It includes an HTTP client for sending requests with headers, body and variables, and a DNS inspector that looks up public DNS records and checks propagation across multiple resolvers. A converter transforms data among JSON, YAML, TOML, XML and CSV, processed locally. It also offers a regex tester with real-time match highlighting, a text compare view, a JWT debugger that shows header, payload and signature, and a port scanner for connectivity and firewall checks. It extends Quick Look with syntax-highlighted previews for 30+ file types.
notable: Native macOS app, described as not built on Electron
Works offline and states it collects no telemetry or analytics
Quick Look extension with syntax-highlighted previews for 30+ file types
Listed in awesome-mac under General Tools
caveats: One-time payment is stated, but the price is not given on the page
